concern_ledger_updates.reason: The Actor conceded the gap and supplied no new admissible artifact showing current-release disclosure of the subgroup weakness.
No new admissible evidence shows approved mitigation or formal risk acceptance; the monitoring point was correctly narrowed but remains insufficient under policy.

final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor provided no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response materially clarifies and narrows the claim, but it does so by reinterpretation of the same record, not by adding the missing compliance artifacts. The admissible evidence still shows three things at once: aggregate operational readiness is positive, the grant-compliance slice materially regressed, and policy requires current-release documentation to reflect current results and disclose material segment weaknesses unless covered by approved mitigation or risk acceptance. The Actor expressly concedes that the present record does not prove disclosure and does not prove approved mitigation or acceptance. That concession makes the position more precise, but it does not convert an unresolved compliance predicate into compliant_with_caveats. A caveated position can support that certification might become supportable if disclosure is added, but on the present record certification is still only conditionally defensible rather than evidentially supported. Because the unresolved issue is specific and policy-bounded rather than evidence of systemic failure, the case remains suspicious rather than noncompliant.
